text_block_list.text:
The summer camp has arrived once
again. A
chance encounter with
Марузенски gives Grass
Wonder the
opportunity to speak with her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After a brief exchange, Марузенски
leaves. Her
shadow looms large in Grass
Wonder's eyes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, Грасс Вандер has grown much
over the
past year. And she isn't finished
yet, so let's start
this summer camp!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
